subject: Founders sweetener conversion -> committed plan request
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@blueberry.io>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-08-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: convert accelerator sweetener to committed credit

Hi Lauren,

Thanks again for the introduction last month. Our founders cohort used the free sandbox sweetener you provided and we want to convert part of that balance to a paid committed plan so we can keep steady throughput for the next 6 months. Budgeting team prefers a committed discount vs continued monthly recharge.

Ask: Can we apply $12,000 of the remaining promo credit to a 6-month committed plan with a 20% discount, and roll over any unused credits into month 7 if usage falls short by >30%?

We can share billing PO and have legal sign a short appendix if needed. Attached: usage-snapshot.pdf

Best,
Samir
CEO, Blueberry.io

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@blueberry.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-08-30T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: convert accelerator sweetener to committed credit

Samir—thanks for the clear ask. Short answer: we can usually do a partial repurpose of promo credits into a committed discount but it'll need approval from pricing & finance. Ben/Irene — can you confirm the account and margin impact? Ben, if we can do 20% off vs list, do we require a 6-month minimum commit of $60k ARR equivalent? Also, legal may want a one-page appendix. Samir—I'll loop back with scope and next steps by end of day.

—Lauren
Head of Growth Solutions
Redwood Inference
Attachment: usage-snapshot.pdf (referenced)

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-09-01T08:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: convert accelerator sweetener to committed credit

Lauren — dug into the numbers. Blueberry has ~ $16k remaining promo balance and steady 30% month-over-month usage growth. Finance is ok with repurposing up to $12k if we get a signed 6-month commitment with monthly consumption thresholds and a clawback clause (standard). Margin check: 20% off on a 6mo commit is tight but acceptable if we require 75% utilization guarantee or linear ramp credits.

Proposed commercial bullets to offer Samir:
- Convert $12,000 promo → applied as first 3 months of committed credit on a 6-month $60k commit
- 20% list discount on committed units
- Unused credits in month 1-3 can roll to month 4 but expire month 7
- Clawback: pro rata refund of discount if aggregated utilization <75% over 6 months

Irene — can you draft a one-page appendix and a short SOW? If legal ok, I can approve the margin carve.

—Ben
Sales, Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood_quote_v2.xlsx

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@blueberry.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-09-02T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: convert accelerator sweetener to committed credit — agreement

Samir — good news. Ben and finance approved a pathway. I attached the one-page appendix and quote. Next steps:
1) Samir signs DocuSign appendix (link below)
2) Blueberry sends PO referencing deal DBL-2025-089
3) We apply $12,000 of promo balance to cover months 1–3 per the quote

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/r/ABCDEFG12345
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/blueberry-io

If that looks good I’ll tag legal to finalize. Thanks — look forward to getting you onto a committed path.

—Lauren
Head of Growth Solutions
Redwood Inference
Attachments: appendix_committed_credit.pdf, redwood_quote_v2.xlsx
